title: Visual builder border, shadow, type, and copy style

entries.summary: Design compiles border, radius, allowlisted box-shadow presets, font-weight, and line-height. Same keys work on section/row/column (except type). Invalid shadow strings are dropped.
Copy style / Paste style (inspector + context menu) copies design or settings bags including device/hover overrides, not content. Live CSS patches the selected node.
No schema change. New keys live in layout_json; CSS remains derived. Shadow is stored as sm/md/lg/none, not raw CSS.
cms-builder-drag-column-size sets 8px radius and md shadow on Module A and asserts both in the editor and public stylesheet.
